results.question: 硕士和本科的平均日薪分别是多少？
results.sql:
SELECT
    education AS 学历,
    ROUND(AVG(salary_avg), 1) AS 平均日薪
FROM jobs
WHERE education IN ('硕士', '本科')
GROUP BY education
ORDER BY 平均日薪 DESC
LIMIT 1
results.gold_sql: select education, round(avg(salary_avg),1) from jobs where education in ('硕士','本科') and salary_avg is not null group by education order by education

results.question: 要求每周5天的岗位平均日薪是多少？

FROM jobs
WHERE days_per_week IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY days_per_week

ORDER BY days_per_week DESC
LIMIT 1
